how_to_apply: Visit the official Central Warehousing Corporation website at www.cewacor.nic.in.
Open Career @CWC (Direct Recruitment)-2026 and locate Advertisement No. 2026/01.
Select Click Here to Apply Online for the relevant recruitment.
Click New Registration and enter your name, contact information and email address.
Record the generated provisional registration number and password.
Complete the application form with the required personal, educational, category and other details.
Upload the prescribed photograph, signature, left thumb impression and handwritten declaration.
Use the preview option to verify the completed application before final registration.
Click Complete Registration after confirming the accuracy of all information.
Proceed to the payment section and pay the applicable examination fee and intimation charges.
Submit the completed form and save the generated e-receipt and application copy.

Important: Candidates cannot change their application details after completing registration. Applicants should ensure that their name, qualification, category, photograph and other information are correct before final submission.

content_sections.heading: CWC Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: CWC has advertised 327 vacancies across eight posts. The details are as follows. PwBD and ex-servicemen reservations are horizontal and are included within the total advertised vacancies. These figures must not be added again to the overall vacancy count. CWC has identified 11 ex-servicemen reserved positions each for Junior Executive (General) and Junior Executive (Technical).

content_sections.heading: CWC Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification Cut-off: Candidates must possess the required marksheets and certificates as of 15 November 2026. Qualifications must be from recognized institutions and must match the subjects and specializations specified in the notification. Finance Experience Condition: For Assistant Manager (Finance), the articleship period will not count toward the required three years of experience. Only regular employment experience is considered under the applicable route.

content_sections.text: Selected candidates will receive the Industrial Dearness Allowance (IDA) pay scale prescribed for their posts. In addition to basic pay and IDA, selected employees will be eligible for applicable allowances and benefits under CWC policies, such as contributory pension, provident fund, gratuity, LTC, medical reimbursement and performance-related benefits, subject to eligibility.

content_sections.heading: CWC Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection stages differ between Assistant Manager and Junior Executive posts. Candidates will be shortlisted for subsequent stages based on examination performance, applicable qualifying standards and the rules prescribed in the notification.

rows.selection_process: Online Examination, Document Verification and Interview

content_sections.heading: CWC Exam Pattern 2026
content_sections.text: The online examination includes objective tests and an English descriptive test. Each post has a separately prescribed distribution of questions and subjects. The total comprises 200 objective questions carrying 200 marks and 2 descriptive questions carrying 30 marks . The exact subject-wise distribution depends on the post. Negative Marking: One-fourth of the marks assigned to each incorrectly answered objective question will be deducted. No penalty applies to unanswered questions. Qualifying Marks: The minimum qualifying marks for the Professional/Subject Knowledge section, wherever applicable, and the English descriptive test are 40% for unreserved candidates and 35% for OBC/EWS/SC/ST/PwBD/Ex-servicemen candidates.

content_sections.heading: CWC Recruitment 2026 Syllabus
content_sections.text: The examination includes reasoning, computer aptitude, quantitative aptitude, data interpretation, general awareness, English language and an English descriptive test. The Technical, Finance and Engineering posts additionally require professional subject knowledge. The detailed notification contains the indicative topic-wise professional syllabus. Candidates should prepare according to the syllabus prescribed for their selected post.

Financial Accounting, Indian Accounting Standards, Cost Accounting, Taxation and Auditing
Structural Engineering, Soil Mechanics, Water Resources, Environmental Engineering, Transportation Engineering, Surveying and Project Management
Electrical Circuits, Electromagnetic Fields and other prescribed Electrical Engineering topics
Mechanical Engineering subjects prescribed in the official syllabus
Technical subject knowledge relevant to the prescribed science disciplines and warehousing operations

content_sections.text: Recent passport-size photograph Signature in black ink Left thumb impression on white paper Handwritten declaration in English Educational qualification marksheets and certificates Age and identity documents Experience certificate, where applicable SC/ST/OBC/EWS/PwBD/Ex-servicemen certificates, where applicable Valid personal email address and mobile number Application fee payment details and receipt The photograph, signature, thumb impression and declaration must meet the format and file-size requirements specified in the detailed notification.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are available in CWC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Central Warehousing Corporation has announced 327 vacancies for Assistant Manager and Junior Executive posts.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for CWC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for online applications and fee payment is 15 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for CWC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The age limit is 18 to 28 years as of 15 November 2026, with applicable relaxation for eligible categories.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for CWC Assistant Manager?
faq.answer: Assistant Manager posts carry the IDA E-1 pay scale of Rs. 40,000–1,40,000.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for CWC Junior Executive?
faq.answer: Junior Executive posts carry the IDA S-V pay scale of Rs. 29,000–93,000.

faq.question: Q6. What is the CWC application fee?
faq.answer: UR, EWS and OBC candidates must pay Rs. 1,350, while SC, ST, women, PwBD and ex-servicemen candidates must pay Rs. 500 as intimation charges. Applicable gateway charges are additional.

faq.question: Q7. Is work experience compulsory for CWC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Experience is required for Assistant Manager (Finance) applicants qualifying through the Commerce graduate route. Other posts do not prescribe experience, and the alternative CA/CMA Intermediate qualification route is provided for Assistant Manager (Finance).

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for Assistant Manager posts?
faq.answer: Selection involves an online examination, document verification and interview.

faq.question: Q9. Is there an interview for CWC Junior Executive posts?
faq.answer: No. The notified selection process for Junior Executive posts consists of an online examination followed by document verification.

faq.question: Q10. What is the CWC Recruitment 2026 examination pattern?
faq.answer: The online examination consists of 200 objective questions and two descriptive questions, carrying a total of 230 marks over three hours. The subject-wise distribution varies according to the selected post.
